name: Marquee row
look: One row of client words, trades, cities or formats moves slowly sideways in a loop, fading at both edges, the first word whole as it starts; it pauses under the pointer and has a pause button after the row, never over a word.
reduced: The words stand in a wrapped row.
phone: It runs on a phone, slower and with a narrower fade, the pause button after the row.

needs.words: 6 to 14 real words (trades, cities, formats), never logos and never invented clients
